rule_outs: Dwelling 7 m from the best section
summary: Steep street by an apartment block with no parked cars along the kerb.
reasons: No cars parked along this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Paragon Crest apartments 7 m away on the same side; a house 14 m at the top end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with a bare verge on the west; room is tight and steep.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street just above a through road.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this kerb; a few sit in the apartment car park.

sun_shade: Large trees shade the upper end and the west verge; open to the east and midday sun.

best_section.where: Lucinda Street west kerb, north of the junction, beside Paragon Crest
